shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- relevant catalog matches ---\\n' && rg -n -i -C 2 'theme|theming|uikit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -100 && printf '\\n--- package/app ---\\n' && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- theme refs ---\\n' && rg -n 'ThemeProvider|theme|Theme' src"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch Button && printf '\\n--- crosscutting ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 'ThemeProvider|theme|Switch|Button' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n--- main and tree ---\\n' && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx && rg --files src"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch Button; printf '\\n--- crosscutting ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 'ThemeProvider|theme|Switch|Button' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; printf '\\n--- main and tree ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx; rg --files src"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch Button; printf '\\n--- docs files ---\\n'; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(README|docs/.+\\.md|ThemeProvider|Switch)' | head -100; printf '\\n--- props declarations ---\\n'; rg -n 'ThemeProvider|interface SwitchProps|type SwitchProps|declare.*Switch|interface ButtonProps|type ButtonProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit --glob '*.d.ts' | head -100; printf '\\n--- root instructions ---\\n'; cat AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'ThemeProvider|Switch|theme|Required setup' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -140; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Control/Control.d.ts 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'interface ControlProps|type ControlProps|onUpdate\\??:|checked\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components --glob '*.d.ts' | head -80; sed -n '52,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; rg -n 'ThemeProvider.*theme|theme.*ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts'"
